<span id="plugins"></span>
== Plugins ==

Each Discord server turns plugins on and off for itself; the data is kept per server and never visible to another. A plugin’s persona text is added to <code>/ask</code> only where it is on.

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Plugin
! Default
! Commands
|-
| <code>community</code>
| on
| <code>/poll</code>, <code>/faq ask\|list\|set\|remove</code>, <code>/rules</code>
|-
| <code>projects</code>
| off
| <code>/task add\|list\|start\|done\|assign\|drop</code>, <code>/standup</code>
|-
| <code>github</code>
| off
| <code>/gh board\|untracked\|issue\|connect</code>
|-
| <code>hub</code>
| on, operators only
| <code>/today</code>, <code>/alerts</code>, <code>/signups</code>, <code>/issues</code>, <code>/reports</code> (needs an AitherOS fleet)
|-
| <code>join</code>
| off
| <code>/enlist</code>, <code>/progress</code>, <code>/certify</code>, <code>/lead</code> (a membership workflow)
|}

Manage with <code>/plugins list|info|enable|disable</code> (enable and disable need Manage Server).

<span id="write-your-own"></span>
=== Write your own ===

<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">awdiscord new-plugin standup-bot      # scaffolds ~/.awdiscord/plugins/standup_bot.py
awdiscord plugins                     # proves it loads</syntaxhighlight>
<syntaxhighlight lang="python">from awdiscord.plugins import Command, Option, Plugin

def hello(ctx):
    return ctx.reply(f"hello <@{ctx.user}>")

PLUGIN = Plugin(name="hello", version="0.1.0", description="Says hello",
                commands=[Command("hello", "Say hello", hello)])</syntaxhighlight>
<span id="packs"></span>
== Packs ==

<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">awdiscord pack install ./packs/dgg_pm
awdiscord pack install https://github.com/org/repo#packs/x
awdiscord pack list | remove NAME</syntaxhighlight>
An '''agent pack''' (<code>brain_pack.yaml</code> / <code>agent.yaml</code> / <code>skills/</code>) becomes a plugin: its system prompt rides along on <code>/ask</code>, its skills are listed to the agent, and <code>/&lt;pack&gt; ask</code> answers in its voice.
